mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, college = #{college}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, contact_visibility = #{contactVisibility}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
